name: Eve Apple
note: Loose apple; the only printed label is the fruit sticker, which reads 'Luvya / eve(TM) / NEW ZEALAND / 3607'. 3607 is a 4-digit PLU code, not a GTIN, so it is not recorded as one. Single-ingredient produce carries no ingredient list, allergen statement or nutrition panel — 'nutrition', 'ingredients' and 'allergens' are listed in needs to record that we looked.
